inferred_variables.name: sigma_build_ln
inferred_variables.units: ln-PSD sigma; reported also in dB

inferred_variables.name: sigma_sensor_ln
inferred_variables.units: ln-PSD sigma; reported also in dB

inferred_variables.name: dome_build[0..10], tray_build[0..10]
inferred_variables.maps_to: per-build dome/tray log-PSD effects (22 latent, non-centered)

fixed_not_inferred.name: flight_to_flight_forcing_variability
fixed_not_inferred.rationale: Known per task card; enters flight QOI likelihood as fixed log-sigma computed by MC.

fixed_not_inferred.name: flight_forcing_covariance
fixed_not_inferred.value: Matern-3/2, ell=0.08 in natural log frequency

fixed_not_inferred.name: flight_mean_force_offset_db
fixed_not_inferred.rationale: Mean flight force PSD is 6 dB below original flat force PSD (from setup packet).

fixed_not_inferred.name: masses
fixed_not_inferred.rationale: Fixed model masses (dome=m1, tray=m2) from fresh 2DOF Constants.

fixed_not_inferred.name: force_amp/force_fc
fixed_not_inferred.rationale: Not used in this staged dataset (vibe uses smoothline base input; modal uses impacts; flight uses Matern forcing GP with known mean). Not inferred.

fixed_not_inferred.name: realized flight forcing GP per flight
fixed_not_inferred.rationale: Latent per-flight forcing realizations not inferred; only their fixed marginal scatter is propagated to the QOI likelihood.

latent_not_inferred_but_present.name: per-frequency flight force PSD realization
latent_not_inferred_but_present.rationale: Only scalar 3*GRMS flight observations are stored in the dataset; the full per-flight PSD is not available, so realized forcing is integrated out via the fixed f2f QOI scatter.

fixed_flight_to_flight_qoi_log_sigma.method: MC of the fixed 3 dB Matern-3/2 forcing GP propagated to 3*GRMS at prior-center structure; 4000 draws, seed 777. Sensor noise contribution is negligible (<1%) because per-frequency iid noise averages out over 260 PSD bins.

data_counts.test_to_test_replicates: none (single vibe + single modal campaign on build 0)
data_counts.flight_to_flight_variability: modeled but FIXED at 3 dB (not learned)

likelihood_data_usage.full_model: whole-curve: every PSD bin (vibe) and every FRF point (3 modal channels) used; flights use scalar 3*GRMS QOI (only data available).
likelihood_data_usage.peak_model: lossy: only peak/notch log-frequency and log-amplitude of vibe peak + 3 modal notches; flights use same scalar 3*GRMS QOI.
likelihood_data_usage.modal_treatment: log-magnitude likelihood (generation scales complex FRF magnitude only via exp(0.5*effect); phase carries no injected noise).

uncertainty_taxonomy.qoi_uncertainty: tray/interface 3*GRMS structural-posterior and future-build-flight predictive intervals

round2_notes: Interface PSD bands are posterior predictive; GIF from 11 sequential NUTS fits (400 warmup / 400 samples per frame).
